title: Alphabet’s $85 Billion Stock Deal Could Open Faucet for Big Tech Offerings
title_zh: Alphabet 850 亿美元的股票交易可能为大型科技产品打开水龙头
summary: Alphabet plans to raise $85 billion through equity sales to fund its 2026 and 2027 capital expenditures.
summary_zh: Alphabet 计划通过股权销售筹集 850 亿美元，为其 2026 年和 2027 年的资本支出提供资金。

title: Broadcom Backing Lowers Debt Costs on $36 Billion Anthropic Deal
title_zh: Broadcom 支持降低 360 亿美元 Anthropic 交易的债务成本
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Broadcom Inc.’s promise to backstop the largest portion of a record-setting microchip financing deal for Anthropic is keeping yields for the deal in check, according to people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: (彭博社)——据知情人士透露，博通公司承诺支持 Anthropic 创纪录的微芯片融资交易的最大部分，这使得该交易的收益率受到控制。

title: U.S. Bancorp Completes BTIG Buyout, Expands Capital Markets Platform
title_zh: U.S. Bancorp 完成 BTIG 收购，扩大资本市场平台
summary: USB completes BTIG buyout, adding equity trading, equity capital markets and M&A advisory to expand its capital markets platform and fee-based revenue mix.
summary_zh: USB 完成 BTIG 收购，增加股权交易、股权资本市场和并购咨询，以扩大其资本市场平台和收费收入组合。
